chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, your mouths are the pathways of the Qur'an, so purify them with the siwak."

key_terms.أَفْوَاهَكُمْ: your mouths; the physical means of recitation and speech
key_terms.الْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an; the divine revelation being recited
key_terms.بِالسِّوَاكِ: with the siwak; with the toothstick used for oral cleansing
key_terms.طُرُقُ: pathways; channels through which the Qur'an is uttered
key_terms.فَطَهِّرُوهَا: so purify them; a command to cleanse the mouth

ai.seo_question: Why is using the siwak recommended before reciting the Qur'an?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام teaches that the mouth has a special sanctity because it is the means by which the Qur'an is recited. For that reason, one should cleanse and purify it with the siwak as part of proper reverence and etiquette toward the Qur'an.
